## Context
The hourly host updater `/Users/joeoakhart/.local/bin/rebar-dev-update.sh` requests `nava-rebar[mcp,reviewbot,ui,agents,eval,tracing,grounding,grounding-t2,dev]`. Current `pyproject.toml` explicitly declares `[dev]` and `[eval]` incompatible because dev includes the Bedrock provider (`boto3>=1.42.63`) while Inspect AI pins aiobotocore to `boto3<1.40.62`. The 2026-08-04 01:27 launchd run failed with uv's unsatisfiable-resolution proof and left `last-good.sha` at `d72c4777`. This blocks the explicit host-runtime refresh required by epic 0303 A2-2 and later A6-1.

## Approach
- Remove only the development-only `dev` extra from the machine-local updater specification; retain the runtime/operator extras, including `agents`, `eval`, `reviewbot`, `mcp`, tracing, UI, and grounding.
- Trigger the updater through launchd so the real minimal-environment path performs an install from the exact current `origin/main` SHA.
- Verify the installed executable and distribution, recorded source SHA, smoke tests, global criteria loading, and the immediately following idempotent no-op.
- Preserve the rollback guard and do not mutate repository files.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] [code-verifiable] The updater install specification omits `dev`, retains `mcp`, `reviewbot`, `ui`, `agents`, `eval`, `tracing`, `grounding`, and `grounding-t2`, and therefore does not request the declared-incompatible `dev`+`eval` pair. Tier: deterministic script-content check.
- [ ] [operator-attested] A launchd-triggered real install exits 0 and advances `last-good.sha` to the exact `origin/main` SHA used for the run.
- [ ] [operator-attested] `/Users/joeoakhart/.local/bin/rebar` resolves to the pipx `nava-rebar` environment.
- [ ] [operator-attested] The installed distribution reports version 0.10.1 and both updater smoke commands exit 0.
- [ ] [operator-attested] The freshly installed global build loads this repository's effective criteria without a configuration error.
- [ ] [operator-attested] An immediately following launchd run logs `no change (already on <installed-sha>)` and exits 0.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] `last-good.sha` is written only inside the branch where both smoke commands exit 0, and the rollback reinstall branch is byte-identical to the pre-change script. Tier: deterministic script diff.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] The updater still resolves `main` with `git ls-remote` and passes that exact SHA to `install_sha`. Tier: deterministic script-content check.

## Files
Machine-local `/Users/joeoakhart/.local/bin/rebar-dev-update.sh`; no repository files.

Scope: XS. Discovered while collecting A2-2 rollout evidence.
